technical.summary: Long-term trend structure bullish (EMA 50/200, price above 200-MA) but short-term momentum weak with bearish MACD, overbought stochRSI, and absent volume confirmation—moderate risk swing entry with conflicting intermediate signals.

fundamental.summary: PLD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 81 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) and recent FOMC event dominate; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 81-day earnings window presents moderate event risk for real estate sector.
